title: Analytics
description: Track every scan with detailed insights while staying privacy-compliant.

sections.title: Privacy and compliance
sections.content: QRise is built with privacy-first principles. We use non-invasive fingerprinting to track unique scans without storing PII (Personally Identifiable Information). Our analytics are GDPR and CCPA compliant by default.

sections.title: Bot filtering
sections.content: We automatically filter out scans from known bots, spiders, and search engine crawlers. This ensures your analytics represent real human engagement.
